snippet.title: Exactly 11 Seconds 🕰️ Riddle #9 Answer + Riddle #10: 2 Jugs, Exactly 4 Litres 💧 #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's clock tower: 6 strikes in 5 seconds. How long for 12?

Answer: 11 seconds, not 10! 6 strikes have only 5 gaps, so each gap is 1 second. 12 strikes have 11 gaps = 11 seconds.

Riddle #10 🫙💧
Person 1 stands at a well with two empty jugs. One holds exactly 3 litres, the other exactly 5 litres. No markings, plenty of water. Person 1 needs EXACTLY 4 litres. No guessing, no filling halfway. How?

Comment your steps 👇 The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
